{{Quote|Count Orom Malvern there is my brother-in-law. He's a toad but he has his uses.|Rodas Borgin|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
'''Orom Malvern''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who belonged to [[House Malvern/Legends|House Malvern]], one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].

==Biography==
Following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the male heirs of the Great Houses&mdash;except [[Adan Dooku]]&mdash; committed parricide when threatened by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the right-hand man of the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly crowned]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Following this event, known as the [[Cleansing of Serenno]], Orom Malvern took his late father's mantle as head of House Malvern.<ref name="AOTE2" />

Malvern's sister [[Cretia Borgin|Cretia]] had [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Rodas Borgin|Rodas]] of the [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]]. The latter considered Malvern an useful idiot, which was the only reason he never envisaged divorce. In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], when the Great Houses struggled to choose a new regent for the [[House Dooku]], Orom Malvern was the only support of his brother-in-law.<ref name="AOTE2" />

Following the apparent "death" of [[Bron Dooku]], Malvern was named [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] of and Regent of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] with support of both the Great Houses, the new Count [[Pero Borgin]], and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial [[Serenno fleet|fleet]].<ref name="AOTE10:HT5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>
